notes.title: "Separate Ways" launch
notes.content:
Fan-favorite Resident Evil 4 additional scenario “Separate Ways” returns as new story DLC on 9/21!
Separate Ways—the missing link in the main story—is a thrilling, survival-horror adventure starring Ada Wong. 
Additionally, on the same day an update arrives for the free DLC "The Mercenaries," adding new playable characters. If you haven't experienced Resident Evil 4 yet, the base game is currently discounted for a limited time!

[previewyoutube=nHCK6Cbn3UM;full]https://youtu.be/nHCK6Cbn3UM[/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2109315/Resident_Evil_4__The_Mercenaries/

[h3]■The mission requires secrecy. Failure is not an option.[/h3]
Play as Ada Wong in this additional scenario and experience the events of Resident Evil 4 from her perspective, filling in unanswered questions posed in the main story. See the other side of the story from her eyes as her mission, and fate, intertwines with Leon Kennedy's a second time.

[h3]■Ada Wong and Albert Wesker are now available in a free update for “The Mercenaries!”[/h3]
A new update adds Ada Wong and Albert Wesker as playable characters.
"The Mercenaries" is a free DLC available to owners of Resident Evil 4, which offers another type of survival experience to players.

notes.title: DirectX 11 Non-Ray Tracing Version Now Available
notes.content:
Hello Resident Evil fans,

Due to overwhelming community response, we've reactivated the previous version that does not include ray tracing and enhanced 3D audio. Both enhanced and previous versions will be made available going forward.

Please follow the steps below if you wish to roll back to the previous version.

1. Click LIBRARY in Steam client.
2. Right-click the game and select ""Properties...""
3. In the pop-up menu, select ""BETAS""
4. From the pull-down menu, select ""dx11_non-rt"" (Note: password not required)
5. Close the pop-up menu and let the Steam client auto-update the game
6. You should be able to launch the game normally once the update completes
7. Please note some of the in-game option settings will be reset as a result of the rollback process.

If you would like to update the game to the new version again, simply select ""None"" from the pull-down menu in Step 4 above.

Resident Evil Team

tags.feature: Both enhanced and previous versions will be made available going forward.

notes.title: Upgrade patches coming for three Resident Evil masterpieces
notes.content:
Resident Evil 2, Resident Evil 3 and Resident Evil 7 biohazard return in 2022 with cutting–edge features including ray tracing, high frame rate and 3D audio for an enhanced gameplay experience(*).

Existing owners of these titles will receive an upgrade patch at no additional cost. 

Stay tuned for more informaton in the future.

* No new gameplay content will be added.

notes.title: New Resident Evil Resistance Update
notes.content:
Today's update includes 2 weapon types for Survivors, a new creature (NE-α), and new skill cards. It also includes specific cards based on Mastermind personality types that can only be used in certain areas. Plus, 35 Survivor skin color variations, 10 creature variations, and much more have been added. A balance update will also be available in the near future.

Update Details
-Survivor Weapon KASHIMA (available in Area 1 and onwards)
-Survivor Weapon RAI-DEN (available in Area 2 and onwards)
-Creature NE-α
-15 Skill Cards
-Equipment Rank cap raised from 20 to 25
-Mastermind now unlocks all skills card at rank 20

Additional details can be found in the official website:
https://www.residentevil.com/re3/

notes.title: Resident Evil Resistance: Nicholai Ginovaef Joins as a New Mastermind
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381048/3f3000aea6fa038f0c12d988d155483421ef600d.png[/img]

[h3][b]Nicholai Ginovaef joins Resident Evil Resistance as a new Mastermind[/b][/h3]

Staying true to Nicholai's profession as a mercenary, he possesses Mastermind skills that allow him to easily track down his targets as well as spotlight his expertise in firearms. He is also able to summon Nemesis as his bioweapon (playable for the first time in a Resident Evil game) to wreak havoc on any Survivors that withstand his onslaught of weaponry and creatures.

Update Information:
https://www.residentevil.com/re3/us/update/index.html



[h3][b]New Resident Evil 2 & 3 Bundle: RACCOON CITY EDITION Now Available![/b][/h3]
Raccoon City Edition is a bundle of Resident Evil 2 and Resident Evil 3, available now on Steam. Experience the entire Raccoon City incident with this bundle, and view the story from start to finish across two full games and multiple character’s perspectives. 

*RACCOON CITY EDITION includes Resident Evil 2, Resident Evil 3 and Resident Evil Resistance

Running won't help, he'll always find you...


A biological disaster has suddenly erupted in Raccoon City, but even as the city descends into chaos another incredible threat has been deployed...

Filled with constant danger and death-defying action, this reimagining of Jill Valentine's desperate flight will exceed all expectations.

Featuring the over-the-shoulder camera of Resident Evil 2, numerous new gameplay systems and action elements have been implemented to make the battles with the relentless Nemesis more intense than ever before.

The asymmetrical-multiplayer online game Resident Evil Resistance is also included.
Two unique survival horror experiences in one package.
